\[
f(x)=x^2+x-6=(x+3)(x-2).
\]

\[
x=-3 \quad\text{and}\quad x=2.
\]

From the graph, \(g(x)\) has roots at

x=-1 \quad\text{and}\quad x=3.
\]

\[
